split_rule: Shuffle unique feature-vector groups; assign first 70% groups to training, next 15% to reserved validation, remainder to test. Keep every raw row and prohibit a feature group crossing splits.
preprocessing: Training-only feature centering/scaling and target centering; no target scaling; validate no missing or constant columns
primary_protocol_relationship: Fixed original solver parameters; independent real-data extension, not a revision of existing raw runs
model_selection: No hyperparameter search and no validation/test-based parameter selection
timing: Includes solver preparation, updates and scheduled certificate/history work; excludes download, parsing, grouping, preprocessing, reference fitting and export
aggregation: median across 3 timings per split/method; then mean and sample SD across 3 overlapping group-based splits
